description: Money for a civil date range in the account timezone (max 366 days; default today): total spent and income in one display currency (the same aggregation as Dayze chat; transfers and IOU anchors left out, rows without an FX quote listed separately, never converted 1:1), plus totals by category and by currency. Optional category matches the expense category (e.g. "food"). Individual transactions are included only with the Financial details permission. ($0.05; API key required)

at.description: Optional ISO instant to read "today" at (defaults to now).

category.description: Optional expense category to total, matched case-insensitively (e.g. food, transport).

from.description: First civil day, YYYY-MM-DD, in the account timezone. Alone = that one day. Default: today.

timezone.description: Optional IANA zone of the user's device (e.g. Asia/Singapore). Used only when the account has no zone set; the profile zone wins.

name: get_finance

totals.description: spent, income and counts in one display currency; unconverted rows listed apart. complete: false means the totals stopped at the row ceiling (see coverage).

title: Get Finance
